Icon Button

Icon buttons are compact buttons that display only an icon without text labels. They save space and are ideal for toolbars and tight UI layouts.

Basic

A simple icon-only button. Always include an aria-label for accessibility.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon" aria-label="Edit">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>
</button>

Sizes

Icon buttons come in three sizes to fit different contexts.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-sm" aria-label="Small">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>
</button>

<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon" aria-label="Default">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>
</button>

<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-lg" aria-label="Large">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>
</button>

Variants

Icon buttons support all the same color variants as regular buttons.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-primary" aria-label="Primary">...</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-secondary" aria-label="Secondary">...</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-success" aria-label="Success">...</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-danger" aria-label="Danger">...</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-warning" aria-label="Warning">...</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-info" aria-label="Info">...</button>

With Tooltip

Icon buttons benefit from tooltips to communicate their purpose on hover.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-primary" aria-label="Edit" title="Edit">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>
</button>

Circle vs Square

Control the border radius to switch between circle and square shapes.

HTML
<!-- Circle icon button (default) -->
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-primary" aria-label="Add">...</button>

<!-- Square icon button -->
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-primary" aria-label="Add" style="border-radius: 0.375rem;">...</button>

CSS Classes

HTML
/* Icon Button Classes */
.zak-btn-icon            /* Base icon button - square padding, centered icon */

/* Size modifiers (same as regular buttons) */
.zak-btn-icon.zak-btn-sm   /* Small icon button */
.zak-btn-icon.zak-btn-lg   /* Large icon button */

/* Shape modifiers */
/* Default: border-radius: 50% (circle) */
/* Override with inline style for square: border-radius: 0.375rem */

Accessibility

  • Always provide an aria-label to describe the button's action.
  • Use title attribute for native tooltips on hover.
  • Ensure the touch target is at least 44x44px for mobile devices.
  • For icon buttons in button groups, use role="group" with an aria-label.
HTML
<!-- Always include aria-label -->
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon" aria-label="Close dialog">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
        <path d="M18 6L6 18M6 6l12 12"/>
    </svg>
</button>

<!-- Grouped icon buttons -->
<div class="zak-btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Formatting options">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-primary" aria-label="Bold">...</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-primary" aria-label="Italic">...</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-icon zak-btn-outline-primary" aria-label="Underline">...</button>
</div>
